# FMC Media PC 0.3.3

- Anime pages now load previous and next seasons through verified AniList prequel/sequel relations, including when opening an upcoming season from Search or Coming soon.
- Season-specific AniList, MAL and Kitsu identifiers stay attached to the corresponding episodes. Choosing Season 1 on a Season 2 page no longer sends Season 2's title or identifiers to source providers.
- The main Play/Resume button follows the selected season. Upcoming seasons remain visible and cannot play undated catalog placeholders before release.
- Verified Dandadan entry routes for Seasons 1, 2 and 3, canonical episode coordinates and per-season source requests.
